kapak.alt: ABR stimulus rate and mains noise

youtube.baslik: Why is the ABR stimulus rate set to a fraction like 21.1? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Stimulus rate is the number of stimuli per second. With a fractional rate such as 21.1, 50 Hz mains interference does not fall into step with the stimulus and cancels in the average. Neurodiagnostic ABR usually uses about 11 to 21 stimuli per second.
